column1: # Declared dynamic-destination placeholder policies per package (SBOB-Forge
# #49, org decision #39 — profiles are honest, never repaired).
# Tab-separated, one policy per line:
#   <PkgDir>
#   kind  = net  -> a Connect candidate whose URL argument is the identifier
#                   <match> lifts to a tier-P egress entry emitting <emit>
#                   (SBOB-Forge netPolicies; variable-identity matching —
#                   declaration alone lifts nothing, an undeclared dynamic
#                   destination still fail-closes).
#   kind  = path -> an Open candidate whose path argument is the identifier
#                   <match> lifts to a tier-P open entry emitting <emit>
#                   (sbobforge pathPolicies with an id).
#   emit = "⋯" (net)  : the declared any-peer destination — materializes as
#                       the spec 5.7 any-peer entry (ipAddresses: ["*"]).
#   emit = "/*" (path) : the declared any-path location — an absolute path
#                       with a `*` tail (spec 5.1: one or more remaining
#                       segments).
# The file is committed and reviewed like code (same contract as
# deferred-plugins.txt): it is the single source of truth for fleet policies
# — configs are derived from it and the csprojs, never hand-edited (#26).
# The coverage report keeps one row per lifted candidate, tier P with the
# policy id as its rule, so every wildcard in a profile answers WHY it is
# there.
# Currently EMPTY: no PluginJobRunner package declares dynamic destinations —
# the plugin packages are pure in-memory transformers (MergeSortArray /
# MergeSortArrayGeneric sort in memory; the contract types declare no
# behavior). Every dynamic-open candidate in the shared test project belongs
# to the HOST's JobExecutorFactory tests (Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), ...)
# RPCF plugin loading), which the generator's namespace-attribution rule
# keeps OUT of the package corpora.
# Evidence: DevelApp-Repo-Global #54; feature: SBOB-Forge #49 (landed as
# PR #50, pinned in the lane's forge ref).
